title: New England Wood Firing Conference 2027 – Host Kiln Firing Week
summary: Join a New England wood-firing crew for a 7-day firing experience, loading, firing and unloading a Host Kiln. Participants fire their own work (2 cubic feet per person) and can tour other Host Kiln sites during cooling.
commitment: June 18-24 stoke crew; unload typically within 7-day firing window
bring: bisqued pots up to 2 cubic feet per attendee
how_to_join: Purchase a ticket on the conference website
source_quote: June 18-26, 2027 An opportunity for potters of all levels to participate with one of NEWFC's Host Kiln crews. June 18-24: Spanning New England, stoke crew participants will join a Host Kiln crew and experience a wood firing from start to finish.
evidence_sentence: The homepage describes a 9-day wood-firing event where participants stoke crews and fire their own works at Host Kilns during the June 18-24 firing week.
evidence_quote: stoke crew participants will join a Host Kiln crew and experience a wood firing from start to finish. In most cases, kilns are loaded, fired and unloaded during Firing Week.
